items.rationale: The police report is required under 2.3.3, but its translation is expressly excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f), so no amount is payable.
Clauses 7.1.8(e) and (f) exclude the provider's working materials and charges ancillary to the excluded translation.

items.description: Stolen watch replaced with a higher-spec model
items.rationale: Under 7.1.9 only the pre-loss equivalent counts; its value is estimated to exceed the €2,500 unscheduled valuables cap under 4.2.2 and 4.4. Allocating the single €150 event deductible under 7.8 proportionally across the €3,000 capped settlement leaves €2,375 for the watch.
The reported €900 cash loss is capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. Its proportional share of the single €150 event deductible is €25, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were not taken in the robbery and are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.5, even though they appear on the same settlement statement.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes shipping even when it is billed alongside covered property, and no insured cost under Part 5 applies.
